items.informal_name: Determinant Absolute Value Bound: $ n! \cdot x^n $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : LinearOrder S]
  [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n R}
  {abv : AbsoluteValue R S} {x : S},
  (∀ (i j : n), abv (A i j) ≤ x) → abv A.det ≤ (Fintype.card n).factorial • x ^ Fintype.card n
items.informal_description: For any square matrix $ A $ of size $ n \times n $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $, and any absolute value $ \text{abv} $ from $ R $ to a partially ordered semiring $ S $, if $ \text{abv}(A_{i,j}) \leq x $ for all entries $ A_{i,j} $, then $ \text{abv}(\det A) \leq n! \cdot x^n $.

items.informal_name: Determinant Bound for Sum of Matrices with Bounded Entries
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : LinearOrder S]
  [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι)
  {A : ι → Matrix n n R} {abv : AbsoluteValue R S} {x : S},
  (∀ (k : ι) (i j : n), abv (A k i j) ≤ x) →
    abv (∑ k ∈ s, A k).det ≤ (Fintype.card n).factorial • (s.card • x) ^ Fintype.card n
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, matrices $ A_k \in M_n(R) $, and an absolute value $ abv: R \to S $, if each entry of each $ A_k $ satisfies $ abv(A_k(i,j)) \leq x $, then the absolute value of the determinant of the sum $ \sum_{k \in s} A_k $ is at most $ (n!) \cdot (|s| \cdot x)^n $, where $ n $ is the size of the matrices and $ |s| $ denotes the cardinality of $ s $.

items.informal_name: Determinant Inequality for Sum of Scaled Matrices with Absolute Value Bounds
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : LinearOrder S]
  [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι)
  {c : ι → R} {A : ι → Matrix n n R} {abv : AbsoluteValue R S} {x : S},
  (∀ (k : ι) (i j : n), abv (A k i j) ≤ x) →
    ∀ {y : S},
      (∀ (k : ι), abv (c k) ≤ y) →
        abv (∑ k ∈ s, c k • A k).det ≤ (Fintype.card n).factorial • (s.card • y * x) ^ Fintype.card n
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, coefficient functions $ c $, matrix functions $ A $, and absolute value $ abv $ from a semiring $ R $ to a partially ordered semiring $ S $, if $ abv(A_k[i][j]) \leq x $ for all $ k,i,j $ and $ abv(c_k) \leq y $ for all $ k $, then the absolute value of the determinant of the sum $ \sum_{k \in s} c_k \cdot A_k $ satisfies $ abv\left(\det\left(\sum_{k \in s} c_k \cdot A_k\right)\right) \leq \left(\text{Nat.factorial}(\#n)\right) \cdot \left(\#s \cdot y \cdot x\right)^{\#n} $, where $ \#n $ denotes the cardinality of the matrix size $ n $.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound in Terms of Coefficient Bounds
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R S] (abv : AbsoluteValue R ℤ) {ι : Type u_5} [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_5 : Fintype ι]
  (bS : Module.Basis ι R S) (a : S) {y : ℤ},
  (∀ (k : ι), abv ((bS.repr a) k) ≤ y) → abv ((Algebra.norm R) a) ≤ ClassGroup.normBound abv bS * y ^ Fintype.card ι
items.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in $ S $, if the absolute value of each coefficient in its representation with respect to the basis $ b_S $ is at most $ y $, then the absolute value of the norm of $ a $ from $ S $ to $ R $ is bounded above by $ \text{normBound} \cdot y^{\#\iota} $, where $ \#\iota $ denotes the cardinality of the finite type $ \iota $.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound in Class Group for Euclidean Domains
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} →
    [inst : EuclideanDomain R] →
      [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
        [IsDomain S] →
          [inst_3 : Algebra R S] →
            AbsoluteValue R ℤ → {ι : Type u_5} → [DecidableEq ι] → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι R S → ℤ
items.informal_description: Given a Euclidean domain $ R $, a commutative domain $ S $ with an $ R $-algebra structure, and a finite basis $ b_S $ for $ S $ over $ R $, let $ n $ be the cardinality of the index set $ \iota $ for the basis. Let $ m $ be the maximum absolute value of entries in the left multiplication matrix representation of $ b_S $. The norm bound is defined as $ n! \cdot (n \cdot m)^n $, where $ n! $ denotes the factorial of $ n $. This integer bound arises from combinatorial and matrix norm considerations in the class group context.
